graph_semantics.node_rule: every node is a mathematical item
graph_semantics.view_rule: trees are extracted views, not the underlying graph
graph_semantics.outgoing_relations_rule: outgoing_relations is derived from graph.edges by grouping edges on source; do not author it as source-of-truth data
graph_semantics.nullable_dependency_class_rule: dependency_class=null means the edge is semantic/descriptive and is not classified as a dependency relation

validation_rules.edge_endpoint_integrity: Every graph.edges[].source and graph.edges[].target must reference an existing graph.items[].id.
validation_rules.domain_integrity: Every graph.items[].domain must reference an existing graph.domains[].id.
validation_rules.item_kind_integrity: Every graph.items[].kind must be listed in schema.item_kinds.
validation_rules.edge_type_integrity: Every graph.edges[].type must be a key in schema.edge_types.
validation_rules.dependency_class_integrity: Every non-null graph.edges[].dependency_class must be listed in schema.dependency_classes.
validation_rules.edge_kind_policy: In strict mode, graph.edges[].source.kind and graph.edges[].target.kind must be allowed by the chosen edge type. In advisory mode, violations are warnings.
validation_rules.kind_specific_fields: Items whose kind has schema.kind_specific_fields should include those fields; missing optional fields may be filled from schema.templates.
validation_rules.derived_outgoing_relations: If outgoing_relations exists on an item, loaders should verify it equals the list of edge ids whose source is that item, or overwrite it.

design_notes: Do not author outgoing_relations on items; materialize it from graph.edges when loading.

concept_map.example_traversal: Start from a root item and traverse requires/prerequisite_for edges by depth.

proof_graph.description: Proof-oriented view linking proofs, proof steps, methods, and results.
proof_graph.example_traversal: From theorem, find incoming proves edges, then traverse proof steps and uses edges.

example_counterexample_map.description: Examples and counterexamples attached to concepts, hypotheses, and theorems.
example_counterexample_map.example_traversal: From a concept or theorem, follow example and counterexample edges.
